About the BFF Bikes Beginner/Intermediate Ride group ride

A casual no-drop cruise around the city for people who have never done a group ride. No experience needed. On the off weeks the shop's Endurance Ride goes 30–50 miles at 16–18 mph.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
